The plugin preserves DSH's exis"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ting session, tool, and permission systems: once signed in, you can select Cursor subscription model"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"s from the model picker, while agent tool calls are executed through DSH's local toolset."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> ⚠️ This plugin integrates with Cursor's unpublished Agent protocol (`agent.v1.AgentService/Run`). "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"It is a community reverse-engineering project and may stop working when Cursor changes its server-si"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"de implementation. Please co"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"mply with Cursor's terms of service."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Use a Cursor subscription directly in DSH through browser-based PKCE sign-in—no API key required.
"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"- Store credentials in DSH's local credential store and refresh access tokens automatically.
- Disco"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ver models available to the current account dynamically through Cursor's `GetUsableModels`, with a b"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"uilt-in fallback list if discovery fails.
- Stream conversations with reasoning output, image attach"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ments, and DSH tool calls.
- View sign-in status and token expiration in the settings page, which la"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"bels itself with the installed build version.
- View and manually refresh subscription usage as Curs"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"or's own dashboard lays it out: an included-usage table with the Cursor Models and Other Models pool"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"s, each followed by the models that drew on it, with token counts and percentages per row, plus incl"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"uded requests, on-demand spend, and the billing cycle.
- View and manually refresh the models availa"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"ble to the current account, listed by name instead of Cursor's response order.
- Configure the per-r"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"un tool-round limit, the HTTP retry policy, and whether every step replays the full history from the"},{"id":"p7s12","text":" settings page.
- Read the settings page in Simplified Chinese, English, Traditional Chinese, Japane"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"se, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, or Arabic. The panel mi"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"rrors itself for Arabic; contributed languages join DSH's own language picker under **Settings → Gen"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"eral → Language** and fall back to English outside the panel."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Install with an Agent (Recommended)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Send the agent a link to AGENTS.md. It contains the instructions for installation, updates, removal,"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ink to AGENTS.md. It contains the instructions for installation, updates, removal, and verification."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Manual Installation with the `dsh` Command"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The installed package list should contain exactly one `dsh-cursor-subscription`, and the composed co"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"nfiguration should contain exactly one `cursor-subscription` entry."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"pnpm 11 and later ship a built-in 24-hour `minimumReleaseAge` gate, so a plain `add` never selects a"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" version published within the last 24 hours. Right after a release, install it explicitly (`dsh plug"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"in --profile web add dsh-cursor-subscription@0.5.8`) or exempt this package by name in the profile's"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Local Development Installation"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Run the following command in the profile directory, such as `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web`:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Then add `dsh-cursor-subscription` to the `dsh.profile.bundles` array in `package.json` and restart "},{"id":"p19s2","text":" add `dsh-cursor-subscription` to the `dsh.profile.bundles` array in `package.json` and restart DSH."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Sign-in and Usage"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"1. Open **Settings -> Cursor Subscription** in DSH.
2. Select **Browser Sign-in**. Your browser will"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" open the Cursor sign-in page.
3. Complete sign-in and authorization. The settings page will automat"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ically show that you are signed in.
4. Select a Cursor model from the model picker, such as `compose"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"r-2` or `claude-4-sonnet`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"When a tool is required, the agent converts Cursor's tool request into a local DSH tool execution. T"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"he result is returned to the model through the conversation history; Cursor's filesystem tools are n"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ot used. When Cursor asks for one of its own built-in tools instead — including a tool newer than th"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"is build knows — the plugin declines that request right away, telling the model to use the DSH tools"},{"id":"p22s5","text":", so the run continues instead of waiting for a result that will never come."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The **Runtime settings** card controls the maximum tool rounds in one Cursor run, the HTTP retry pol"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"icy, and whether each step replays the full history. The tool-round cap defaults to `200` (range 1–1"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"000) and ends the run with `TOOL_LIMIT` when exceeded. Retry count means additional attempts and def"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"aults to `0` (disabled). Cursor's streaming POST protocol cannot prove that a failed attempt was not"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" processed remotely, so enabling retries may repeat model work or usage. Retries occur only before a"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ny response output when the initial HTTP status matches the configured list. **Replay the full histo"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"ry each step** is off by default: it rebuilds the Cursor conversation from the DSH history on every "},{"id":"p23s8","text":"step instead of resuming the conversation Cursor keeps server-side, which is what an adapter that re"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"-sends its own history does — at the cost of re-sending the transcript each step, since Cursor has n"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"o provider-side compaction to bound it."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Updating and Removing"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"If DSH is running, restart it manually after installation or an update."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Scope and Support"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Image *input* (user-uploaded attachments) is supported. Cursor-native features such as image gener"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ation and web search remain outside this plugin's scope.
